name: Asteroid
notes: The site footer names Entropy Systems, Inc. as the operator. The homepage describes three execution modes: a frontier model reading the screen and acting on first runs, agent-written deterministic scripts for repeat runs, and direct calls to a portal's private API when one is found; it also describes an agent builder (Astro), approval checkpoints and step-by-step run recordings. An August 2026 company blog post says Asteroid has deployed agents built on Anthropic's computer use tool since February 2026 as an early-access participant, and that its agents run on Linux sandboxes and reach Windows-only EHRs through remote desktop. Customer outcome figures, HIPAA and SOC 2 claims, pricing and reliability are publisher statements.
summary: Hosted healthcare automation platform whose agents operate EHRs, payer portals and Windows, Linux or Citrix apps from the screen, then turn repeat runs into scripts or private-API calls served as an API.
